description_en: Queries interval-based summary reports of agent metrics by calling ListAgentSummaryReportsByInterval
description_zh: 调用ListAgentSummaryReportsByInterval查询坐席指标的分段汇总报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-agent-summary-reports-by-interval --instance-id b0eb2742-f37e-4c67-82d4-25c651c1xxxx --skill-group-id 8fb654c6-17c6-4501-ba57-f5ddeb91xxxx --agent-ids 276970771142947xxxx --interval Daily --start-time 2018-09-12_14:45:00 --end-time 2018-09-12_14:45:00 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentSummaryReportsByInterval

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the skill group
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of agent IDs separated by commas (,). An agent ID is the same as the RAM user ID of the agent. A maximum of 50 agents can be specified. If this parameter is not specified, all agents are queried
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID列表（使用“,”隔开），坐席ID等同于该座席的RAM子账户ID，最多50个坐席；不传查询全部
parameters.name: agent_ids

parameters.help_en:
The interval type. Valid values:
Daily: by day
Minute5: by 5 minutes
parameters.help_zh:
间隔类型。
Daily：天
Minute5：5分钟
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The start date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The date cannot be earlier than 6 months before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 起始日期，格式yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，不得早于6个月前的时间点
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值为10，最大是100
parameters.name: page_size
